You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From ffea9fb319360b9ead8befac6bb2db2b54fd53e6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Date: Wed, 16 Mar 2022 13:41:46 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] sched/headers: ARM needs asm/paravirt_api_clock.h too

Add <asm/paravirt_api_clock.h> for arch/arm/, mapped to <asm/paravirt.h>,
to simplify #ifdeffery in generic code.

Fixes this build error introduced by the scheduler tree:

  In file included from ../kernel/sched/core.c:81:
  ../kernel/sched/sched.h:87:11: fatal error: asm/paravirt_api_clock.h: No such file or directory
     87 | # include <asm/paravirt_api_clock.h>

Reviewed-by: Nathan Chancellor <nathan@kernel.org>
Fixes: 4ff8f2ca6ccd ("sched/headers: Reorganize, clean up and optimize kernel/sched/sched.h dependencies")
Signed-off-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Signed-off-by: Ingo Molnar <mingo@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220316204146.14000-1-rdunlap@infradead.org
---
 arch/arm/include/asm/paravirt_api_clock.h | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
 create mode 100644 arch/arm/include/asm/paravirt_api_clock.h

diff --git a/arch/arm/include/asm/paravirt_api_clock.h b/arch/arm/include/asm/paravirt_api_clock.h
new file mode 100644
index 000000000000..65ac7cee0dad
--- /dev/null
+++ b/arch/arm/include/asm/paravirt_api_clock.h
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+#include <asm/paravirt.h>
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the absence of the header file `asm/paravirt_api_clock.h` in the ARM architecture, which was required by the scheduler code in `sched.h`. This missing file led to a build error when the scheduler code attempted to include it, resulting in a fatal error indicating that the file could not be found. The patch addressed this by creating the missing header file and mapping it to `asm/paravirt.h`, thereby simplifying conditional compilation in the generic code.

    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>

    <textN>

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was the absence of the header file `asm/paravirt_api_clock.h` in the ARM architecture, which was required by the scheduler code in `sched.h`. This missing file led to a build error when the scheduler code attempted to include it, resulting in a fatal error indicating that the file could not be found. The patch addressed this by creating the missing header file and mapping it to `asm/paravirt.h`, thereby simplifying conditional compilation in the generic code.
